in_marathi.name: Sharvasya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Saraswati's Abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvasya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sarasvat', which refers to the goddess Saraswati. 'Saraswat' means 'abode of Saraswati'. Saraswati is the goddess of knowledge, learning, music, and wisdom.
